text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! All right, Brian, now be good
and come
with me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch. What are you playing at?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I've got a message from Air
Groove. "We
both know damn well you
can finish that job
today, so get to it,
you procrastinator." Chop
chop!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I refuse. Rudolf said the deadline's
flexible, so
there's still time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I finish this one early, they'll just pile
on extra
errands. There's nothing in it for
me, so why
bother?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well then, let's incentivize doing
things
early!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
From now on, when you wrap up tasks
early, I'll
give you a little treat! ♪ What
should the treat
be? Coupons for extra
meat?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hang on, don't get too excited. I never
said I'd—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ooor, how about a coupon for less
veggies? A
coupon for a pair run with
me? Or maybe a
coupon to let one little
thing slide?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. So, what do you think? Why not
wrap up
that little task real quick and
give the coupon
thing a try?
